instruction.text: Read the following text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Temi walked down the hill. The pavement was covered with brown and golden leaves, and the air was crisp and cold. She tried to walk as quickly as possible. She kept checking her watch because she only had 10 minutes to get to work. She couldn’t afford to be late to work again .

atoms.a: What time of year could it be?
Why do you think Temi was walking quickly?
b: she wanted a run before work
she wanted some fresh air before work

atoms.a: Which extract suggests that Temi is often late?
b: ++“She couldn’t afford to be late to work again.”
“The pavement was covered with brown and golden leaves, ...”
“She tried to walk as quickly as possible.”
